constraints: Only works between processes running on the same machine.
Does nothing if the target process does not exist or is not currently displaying a form.
Requires the On Outside Call form event to be enabled (in Form Properties) and handled in the target form's method, otherwise nothing happens.

Has an immediate, non-blocking effect: the caller process does not wait for a reply; a reply must be implemented manually (e.g. via interprocess/process variables read/written with GET PROCESS VARIABLE and SET PROCESS VARIABLE).
